title: Show evidence-based queue wait estimates and heavy-run scheduling
description: Record comparable test runtimes, bounded wait estimates with uncertainty, slowdown alerts, project-declared GPU/card-exclusive leases and optional overnight placement for heavy checks. Never treat old heterogeneous timing as an exact promise or bypass queue ordering to prioritize a waiting UI card.
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard distinguishes measured duration from uncertain queue prediction
GPU-exclusive jobs cannot overlap incompatible work and heavy jobs obey approved windows
Sparse samples show unknown; cancellation/recovery preserves audit and wakes stopped waiters
